broader_actor_lookup.scope: Read-only repeat lookup over the same exhausted time window, exact owned role ARNs, no service-actor filter. No matching denied assumptions observed; not a universal absence guarantee.

correlation: Exact successfully created role ARN and apigateway.amazonaws.com service actor; no association with an individual HTTP request is inferred.
redaction: Redacts secret access keys/session tokens; hashes access key identifiers and client IP addresses.
cleanup: Read-only event-history lookup; no resources created or changed.
